label: Webhook-to-Tulip Bridge
info:
Generic webhook to Tulip Tables bridge.

Configure environment variables on this flow tab, then edit the 'Extract & Route' function node to define your extraction rules.

Debug nodes are wired at each stage — open the debug sidebar (bug icon, top right) to watch messages flow. Disable individual debug nodes by clicking the toggle on their right edge.

name: Set env vars on this tab, then edit the 'Extract & Route' node
info:
Required env vars:
- TULIP_INSTANCE_URL
- TULIP_API_KEY
- TULIP_API_SECRET

Workspace:
- TULIP_WORKSPACE (use DEFAULT for the default workspace;
  required for account-level tokens or multi-workspace instances)

Optional auth:
- WEBHOOK_SECRET
- AUTH_TYPE: hmac, bearer, or none
- HMAC_HEADER, HMAC_ALGORITHM, HMAC_PREFIX

name: Verify auth
Extract & Route (EDIT THIS)
info:
Edit this function to define your webhook extraction logic.

Output 1 sends the HTTP response (quick ack).
Output 2 sends route messages for async Tulip processing.
